hint.en: Triggers on every new location report from the ConnectModule, including while riding or charging. Combine with your own conditions (e.g. 'and I am not home') for custom anti-theft flows. For the filtered version, use the 'possible alarm' card instead. Tip: enable Bosch eBike Lock so a thief cannot simply power on and ride. Requires a ConnectModule with the eBike Alarm feature; checked every 5 minutes.
